title: Calibration Uncertainty in Adaptive Large Language Model Evaluation: code, data, frozen analysis plans and artifacts
description: Docker-only reproduction package for the paper 'Calibration Uncertainty in Adaptive Large Language Model Evaluation: Theory and Empirical Evidence' (EOST-M). Contains the code, the frozen analysis plans and their SHA-256 locks (configs/PREREGISTRATION.lock.json, configs/STUDY2.lock.json), the processed response matrices that may be redistributed, every artifact with its hash manifest (artifacts/ARTIFACT_MANIFEST.json), and the manuscript (the article and its extended version with every secondary table and figure). The study-2 plan was frozen on 2026-11-04T04:02:37Z (git commit bd46f79); depositing this record does not make it a preregistration, but makes the final package immutable and publicly verifiable.
